### Applicable Subscription Plans
The web interface at `gemini.google.com` (Gemini Apps) can be accessed under two distinct tiers of service:
* **Consumer / Personal Plans:** Free Google accounts and **Gemini Advanced** (via Google One AI Premium).
* **Business & Enterprise Plans:** **Google Workspace** editions with Gemini (including **Gemini Business**, **Gemini Enterprise**, and **Gemini for Education**) which grant enterprise-grade data protections and administrative governance.

---

### Governance Attributes

#### 1. `sso_available`
* **Consumer Plans:** Not available. Access relies on standard personal Google Account authentication.
* **Enterprise / Google Workspace Plans:** **Yes.** When accessed with a work or school account, `gemini.google.com` inherits the Google Workspace organization's identity configuration, which supports Single Sign-On (SSO) via SAML 2.0 or OIDC third-party Identity Providers (IdPs), as well as Google as the IdP.

#### 2. `data_retention`
* **Consumer Plans:** Managed under **Gemini Apps Activity**. By default, conversations are retained for **18 months**, with user settings to set auto-deletion at 3 months, 36 months, or indefinite. If Gemini Apps Activity is turned off, conversations are temporarily retained for up to **72 hours** to provide the service and process feedback. Data selected for human review is decoupled from the Google account and kept for up to **3 years**.
* **Enterprise / Google Workspace Plans:** Admins control conversation history policies. Conversation history is retained by default for **18 months**, and administrators can configure auto-deletion at 3, 18, or 36 months, or turn history off completely. Organizations can also govern retention, legal holds, and eDiscovery using **Google Vault**.

#### 3. `training_on_customer_data`
* **Consumer Plans:** **Yes.** Conversations, prompts, and related usage data may be human-reviewed and used by Google to train and improve machine learning models and Google products.
* **Enterprise / Google Workspace Plans:** **No.** Under Google Workspace enterprise data protections, prompts, uploaded files, and generated responses stay within the organization and are **not** reviewed by humans or used to train Google's foundation AI models without explicit customer permission.

#### 4. `admin_controls_available`
* **Consumer Plans:** **No.** Controls are restricted to personal user-level settings.
* **Enterprise / Google Workspace Plans:** **Yes.** Google Admin Console provides granular administrative controls, including:
  * Turning the Gemini app on or off for specific organizational units (OUs) or groups.
  * Managing organization-wide conversation history and retention settings.
  * Restricting sharing of Gemini app conversations.
  * Regulating data access permissions, Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies, and auditing activities through Google Vault and the Security Investigation Tool.

#### 5. `enterprise_plan_available`
* **Yes.** Enterprise plans are available via Google Workspace with **Gemini Business**, **Gemini Enterprise**, and Google Workspace for Education editions, enabling enterprise-level agreements, compliance coverage (e.g., HIPAA, FERPA), and enterprise data protection terms for `gemini.google.com`.

Governance attributes for **GitHub** (`github.com`) based on official documentation:

---

### 1. `enterprise_plan_available`
* **Status:** Available.
* **Details:** GitHub provides a dedicated **GitHub Enterprise** tier, available as **GitHub Enterprise Cloud** (hosted by GitHub) and **GitHub Enterprise Server** (self-hosted).
* **Applicable Plans:** GitHub Enterprise.

---

### 2. `sso_available`
* **Status:** Available.
* **Details:** 
  * GitHub supports Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML) Single Sign-On (SSO) to integrate with Identity Providers (IdPs) such as Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, and others.
  * Organizations and enterprises can enforce SAML SSO across enterprise accounts and organizations.
  * Enterprises using **Enterprise Managed Users (EMU)** configure SAML SSO and SCIM to provision and manage account lifecycles.
* **Applicable Plans:** GitHub Enterprise (GitHub Enterprise Cloud and GitHub Enterprise Server); SAML SSO can also be configured at the organization level on GitHub Enterprise Cloud.

---

### 3. `admin_controls_available`
* **Status:** Available.
* **Details:** 
  * **Role-Based Access Control (RBAC):** Administrative roles exist at the enterprise level (Enterprise Owner, Billing Manager, Enterprise Open-Source License Manager, App Manager, Security Manager, and Custom Roles) and organization level (Organization Owner, Billing Manager, Member, Security Manager, Custom Roles).
  * **Policy Enforcement:** Enterprise owners can centrally manage and enforce policies across organizations (e.g., repository creation rules, branch protection rules, two-factor authentication enforcement, external collaborator access).
  * **User Provisioning & Directory Management:** Supports SCIM provisioning and Enterprise Managed Users (EMU).
  * **Audit & Monitoring:** Comprehensive audit log capabilities (web interface, REST API, JSON/CSV export, and audit log streaming to SIEM/external storage).
* **Applicable Plans:** GitHub Free/Team provide standard organization-level admin controls; centralized enterprise-wide administration, custom enterprise roles, EMU, audit log streaming, and policy management require **GitHub Enterprise**.

---

### 4. `data_retention`
* **Status:** Documented / Configurable.
* **Details:**
  * **Audit Log Retention:**
    * In GitHub Enterprise Cloud, audit log web events are retained and searchable via the web interface, JSON/CSV exports, and REST API for **180 days**; Git events are retained for **7 days**. Organizations/enterprises can configure audit log streaming to retain event logs indefinitely in external SIEM/storage.
    * In GitHub Enterprise Server, audit log retention is indefinite by default and can be customized by enterprise administrators.
  * **GitHub Actions, Workflows, and Artifacts Retention:**
    * Public repositories: Configurable between 1 and 90 days.
    * Private/internal repositories: Configurable between 1 and 400 days.
  * **Deployment Statuses:** GitHub retains previous deployment status records for 90 days.
* **Applicable Plans:** Standard retention periods apply across plans; configurable retention settings for workflows/artifacts and audit log retention controls/streaming are managed in **GitHub Enterprise** and GitHub organization settings.

report_blocks.text:
### Applicable Subscription Plans

GitHub Copilot is offered across several subscription tiers:
* **Individual Plans:** GitHub Copilot Free, GitHub Copilot Student, GitHub Copilot Pro, GitHub Copilot Pro+, and GitHub Copilot Max.
* **Organization & Enterprise Plans:** GitHub Copilot Business and GitHub Copilot Enterprise (as well as *Copilot access* for eligible GitHub Enterprise Cloud accounts).

---

### Governance Attributes

#### 1. `sso_available`
* **Status:** Available.
* **Details:** Single Sign-On (SSO) via SAML is supported for GitHub Copilot in organization and enterprise deployments. Organizations can configure SAML SSO directly or use Enterprise Managed Users (EMU) with identity providers (such as Microsoft Entra ID or Okta) using SAML/OIDC and SCIM provisioning. GitHub also supports dedicated enterprise accounts specifically for administering Copilot Business licenses with SSO without requiring full GitHub Enterprise Cloud licenses for source code. Individual accounts sign in using personal GitHub credentials.
* **Sources:** GitHub Docs (*About enterprise accounts for Copilot Business*, *About SAML for enterprise IAM*).

---

#### 2. `data_retention`
* **Status:** Documented / Tier-dependent.
* **Details:** 
  * **Copilot Business & Copilot Enterprise:** GitHub does not retain prompts or generated suggestions; they are processed in transient memory to generate completions and discarded once delivered. User engagement/telemetry data is retained for up to two years under GitHub’s Data Protection Agreement, while rolling user activity metrics and audit log timestamps are retained for 90 days. Web/cloud chat session data outside the IDE may be retained for 28 days. Copilot Memory facts and preferences expire after 90 days of disuse unless reinforced (configurable between 7 and 180 days by enterprise admins).
  * **Individual Plans (Free, Pro, Pro+, Max):** If users permit data sharing for model training, interaction data (prompts, suggestions, and context snippets) is retained on disk. If the training toggle is disabled, interaction data is processed in real-time in memory and discarded.
* **Sources:** GitHub Copilot Trust Center FAQ (*How long does GitHub retain Copilot data for Business and Enterprise customers?*); GitHub Docs (*Metrics data properties for GitHub Copilot*, *About GitHub Copilot Memory*, *GitHub Copilot on GitHub.com and GitHub Mobile*).

---

#### 3. `training_on_customer_data`
* **Status:** Not trained on Business/Enterprise; Opt-out/setting-controlled on Individual plans.
* **Details:** 
  * **Copilot Business & Copilot Enterprise:** GitHub does not use customer data (including code, prompts, or generated suggestions) to train AI models; contractual agreements and Data Protection Agreements strictly prohibit model training on this data. Third-party model providers (e.g., Anthropic, Google) also do not train models on enterprise customer data.
  * **Individual Plans (Free, Pro, Pro+, Max):** Interaction data may be collected and used for model training under GitHub's Privacy Statement unless the user opts out by setting "Allow GitHub to use my data for AI model training" to *Disabled* in their personal account privacy settings.
* **Sources:** GitHub Copilot Trust Center FAQ; GitHub Docs (*Hosting of models for GitHub Copilot*).

---

#### 4. `admin_controls_available`
* **Status:** Available.
* **Details:** Administrative governance and policy controls are provided for organization and enterprise administrators via GitHub Copilot Business and GitHub Copilot Enterprise. Controls include:
  * Policy toggles to block or allow suggestions matching public code.
  * AI Controls for enabling, restricting, or delegating specific LLM models, third-party agents, and plugins.
  * Content exclusion policies to block specified files, directories, or repositories from being indexed or processed by Copilot.
  * Centralized seat assignment, spending caps/budgets for GitHub AI Credits, enterprise-managed client settings, and access to organization-wide usage metrics and activity reports.
* **Sources:** GitHub Docs (*Setting up an enterprise for GitHub Copilot Business only*, *Managing GitHub Copilot in your enterprise*, *Choosing your enterprise's plan for GitHub Copilot*).

---

#### 5. `enterprise_plan_available`
* **Status:** Available.
* **Details:** GitHub provides enterprise-specific plans:
  * **GitHub Copilot Business:** Intended for organizations and enterprises needing centralized license management, policy governance, and data privacy protections.
  * **GitHub Copilot Enterprise:** Designed for organizations using GitHub Enterprise Cloud, adding organizational codebase indexing, pull request summaries, integration into GitHub.com workflows, larger credit allowances, and advanced governance features.
* **Sources:** GitHub Docs (*Plans for GitHub Copilot*, *Choosing your enterprise's plan for GitHub Copilot*).

---

### **3. Admin Controls Available (`admin_controls_available`)**

* **Details:** 
  * **Role-Based Permissions & Groups:** IT and team admins can assign workspace roles, permissions, and manage groups.
  * **Credit Spend Controls:** Admins can manage and disable credit spending on a per-user basis in team settings.

  * [Jasper Success Center - Credits-Based Pricing](https://support.jasper.ai)

---

* **Status:** Documented.
* **Details:**
  * **Customer Data:** Retained for the duration of the agreement. Following termination, data is retained in accordance with Jasper’s Data Retention Policy unless a written deletion request is submitted.
  * **Audit & Monitoring Logs:** Production and monitoring logs are retained for at least one year; workspace admin audit logs retain 90 days of events.

  * According to Jasper's Software as a Service Agreement and End User License Agreement (EULA), Jasper states under *Non-Training of Models* that it *"shall not use, nor permit a third party to use, Customer Property to train artificial intelligence models utilized by the Service"*.
  * Jasper’s public security and pricing materials confirm that customer data and inputs/outputs are never used to train third-party LLMs or underlying foundation models.

Users authenticate using their organizational Microsoft 365 credentials via protocols such as OpenID Connect (OIDC) and SAML, maintaining persistent SSO sessions across the Teams web client (`teams.microsoft.com`), desktop, and mobile applications.  
  * **Sources:** [Microsoft Learn: What is single sign-on in Microsoft Entra ID?](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/enterprise-apps/what-is-single-sign-on); [Microsoft Learn: Enable SSO with Microsoft Entra ID](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/platform/tabs/how-to/authentication/tab-sso-overview).

---

* **`data_retention`**: **Yes**  
  * **Details:** Retention policies for Microsoft Teams are configured and managed via the Microsoft Purview portal. Administrators can establish automated retention rules for Teams chats, channel messages, shared channel messages, and meeting recordings. Policies can be configured to retain data indefinitely, retain data for a specific duration, delete data after a designated time period, or retain and then permanently delete content.  
  * **Sources:** [Microsoft Learn: Manage retention policies for Microsoft Teams](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/retention-policies-teams); [Microsoft Learn: Learn about retention policies & labels to retain or delete](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/retention).

* **`admin_controls_available`**: **Yes**  
  * **Details:** Microsoft provides dedicated centralized management via the Microsoft Teams admin center (`admin.teams.microsoft.com`), Microsoft 365 admin center, and Teams PowerShell module. Administrators can enforce granular org-wide default settings, custom policies (messaging, meetings, calling, external access, and app permissions), administrative units, and role-based access control (RBAC) via Entra ID roles (such as Teams Administrator, Teams Communications Administrator, and Teams Device Administrator).  
  * **Sources:** [Microsoft Learn: Manage teams in the Microsoft Teams admin center](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/manage-teams-in-modern-portal); [Microsoft Learn: Use Microsoft Teams administrator roles to manage Teams](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/using-admin-roles); [Microsoft Learn: Teams settings and policies reference](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/settings-policies-reference).

---

* **`enterprise_plan_available`**: **Yes**  
  * **Details:** Microsoft offers a standalone enterprise SKU designated as **Microsoft Teams Enterprise**, as well as full enterprise bundles through **Microsoft 365 Enterprise** (e.g., E3/E5) and **Office 365 Enterprise** (e.g., E1/E3/E5) tailored for organizations of any size with enterprise-grade compliance, security, and administrative management.  
  * **Sources:** [Microsoft: Microsoft Teams Pricing for Enterprise](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-teams/compare-microsoft-teams-enterprise-options); [Microsoft: Microsoft 365 Enterprise Plans and Pricing](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/enterprise/plans-and-pricing); [Microsoft: Microsoft Teams Enterprise](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-teams/enterprise).

report_blocks.text:
### Applicable Subscription Plans
Midjourney officially offers four subscription tiers:
* **Basic Plan**
* **Standard Plan**
* **Pro Plan**
* **Mega Plan**

*(Note: For organizations requiring 50 or more yearly Pro or Mega subscriptions, Midjourney offers a bulk/corporate billing arrangement, but these remain standard Pro/Mega licenses without custom enterprise software features).*

---

### Governance Attributes

#### 1. `enterprise_plan_available`
* **Status:** No (Dedicated Enterprise tier not available; bulk billing available for standard plans)
* **Details:** Midjourney does not offer a dedicated "Enterprise" subscription plan tier. It only provides bulk billing arrangements for organizations purchasing 50 or more yearly Pro or Mega plans. Midjourney explicitly notes that it does not offer custom terms, policy negotiations, or security process reviews.
* **Source:** *Midjourney Docs – Comparing Midjourney Plans*; *Midjourney Docs – Group Plans & Corporate Billing*.

#### 2. `sso_available`
* **Status:** No
* **Details:** Single Sign-On (SSO / SAML) is not supported. Midjourney's corporate documentation explicitly states: *"Please note that we do not offer the following: ... SSO logins."* Authentication is restricted to individual Discord or Google accounts.
* **Source:** *Midjourney Docs – Group Plans & Corporate Billing*; *Midjourney Docs – Logging In & Connecting Accounts*.

#### 3. `admin_controls_available`
* **Status:** No
* **Details:** Midjourney does not offer centralized administrative controls, centralized workspace administration, or seat management. Documentation explicitly specifies: *"Please note that we do not offer the following: Seat or admin management"* and advises organizations setting up multiple accounts to manually track each user's login and ID in a spreadsheet.
* **Source:** *Midjourney Docs – Group Plans & Corporate Billing*.

#### 4. `data_retention`
* **Status:** Retained as long as necessary for business purposes; deletion within 30 days upon request
* **Details:** Midjourney retains personal data (including prompts and user information) *"for as long as necessary to serve an allowable purpose"* (e.g., providing and improving services, account management, legal compliance). Users may request account and data deletion via their account settings; users have a 7-day grace period to reverse the request, and the account and associated data are deleted within 30 days of submission.
* **Source:** *Midjourney Docs – Data Deletion and Privacy FAQ*; *Midjourney Docs – Privacy Policy*.

#### 5. `training_on_customer_data`
* **Status:** Yes
* **Details:** Midjourney trains its AI models on user interaction data. In its official *Public Summary of Training Content*, Midjourney answers **"Yes"** to the disclosure: *"Was data from user interactions with the AI model (e.g. user input and prompts) used to train the model?"* (covering text and image modalities). While Pro and Mega plans include "Stealth Mode" to prevent creations from being publicly listed in the community gallery, it does not exempt inputs and assets from model improvement or internal processing.
* **Source:** *Midjourney Docs – Public Summary of Training Content*; *Midjourney Docs – Privacy Policy*.

report_blocks.text:
### Applicable Subscription Plans
Visual Studio Code (VS Code) is a standalone, free editor provided under the Microsoft Software License Terms (with source code open-sourced under the MIT license). There are **no tiered subscription plans** (such as Free, Pro, or Enterprise) for VS Code itself; all features and enterprise governance capabilities are included in the standard distribution.

---

### Governance Attributes

* **`sso_available`**: **Yes**
  * VS Code includes native authentication providers supporting Microsoft Entra ID (work or school accounts) and GitHub accounts. 
  * VS Code utilizes the Microsoft Authentication Library (MSAL) to enable Single Sign-On (SSO) flows and supports SAML SSO session management for GitHub Enterprise accounts.

* **`data_retention`**: **Documented / Configurable**
  * **Telemetry & Crash Reporting:** Microsoft documents that data retention policies are enforced for telemetry and diagnostic crash dumps in compliance with GDPR. Telemetry collection can be controlled or turned off entirely via `telemetry.telemetryLevel`.
  * **Settings Sync:** Preferences and configuration data synced to the cloud remain until the user clears or deletes cloud data directly via the Settings Sync controls.
  * **AI & Language Models:** VS Code includes options such as Zero Data Retention (ZDR) endpoint configurations (`zeroDataRetentionEnabled`) and documents that external provider policies govern chat session and cloud memory retention.

* **`admin_controls_available`**: **Yes**
  * VS Code provides centrally managed **Enterprise Policies** that override local user and workspace settings across Windows, macOS, and Linux.
  * Administrators can enforce policies via Windows Group Policy (ADMX/ADML templates), Microsoft Intune, macOS MDM profiles, or Linux policy JSON files.
  * Configurable controls include:
    * **Extension Governance:** Allowlisting/blocklisting extensions by ID, publisher, or platform, and configuring private marketplaces.
    * **Automatic Updates:** Restricting or disabling updates via the `UpdateMode` policy (e.g., `manual`, `none`, or `start`).
    * **Telemetry Level:** Centrally setting or turning off diagnostic telemetry.
    * **AI and Copilot Controls:** Restricting agent access, tool approvals, and MCP server discovery.

* **`enterprise_plan_available`**: **No**
  * There is no commercial "Enterprise Plan" for VS Code. The application is completely free for both private and commercial enterprise use. 
  * Enterprise-grade management features (such as Group Policy, MDM support, and centralized policy enforcement) are built into the standard, free release without requiring an enterprise license. *(Note: VS Code can interface with external enterprise services, such as private extension marketplaces connected to a GitHub Enterprise account).*

---

* [Microsoft Software License Terms – Visual Studio Code](https://code.visualstudio.com/license)
* [Visual Studio Code for Enterprise](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/enterprise/overview)
* [Centrally Manage VS Code Settings with Policies](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/enterprise/policies)
* [Manage Updates in Enterprise Environments](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/enterprise/updates)
* [Visual Studio Code Telemetry & Privacy Documentation](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/configure/telemetry)
* [Visual Studio Code Settings Sync](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/configure/settings-sync)
